## Rethinking how products get built


AI has accelerated individual work, but that doesn’t automatically make teams better at building products. See how Atlassian is redesigning its product development lifecycle (PDLC) to connect people, agents, and context.


[Read the playbook](https://atlassianblog.wpengine.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/ai-pdlc-playbook.pdf)

## Transforming our own teams


Building better products won’t come from AI alone. We need to rethink how product, design, and engineering work together, and how people and agents turn ideas into customer value.


This is no small undertaking. At Atlassian, we have nearly 10,000 R&D employees, and we’re testing new ways of working across both greenfield projects and complex legacy systems with strict security requirements.


We’re sharing what we’ve learned so our customers can navigate these same challenges and accelerate their own AI transformations.


The next leap in AI productivity will come from redesigning how the entire product development system turns ideas into customer value.


## Three core learnings


- **Aim human attention where it changes the outcome.**
Let agents handle repeatable work while people focus on consequential decisions.
- **Context should travel with the work—and compound.**
Keep decisions, requirements, and lessons connected so every person and agent can build on what came before.
- **Widen contribution, protect craft accountability and ambition** .
Enable more people and agents to contribute while experts set the standards, raise the quality bar, and remain accountable for outcomes.


## Results


- **Vulnerability remediation: ~50 engineering days saved every week.** Agents investigate and propose fixes for vulnerabilities, engineers approve every change before it merges.
- **Code as a design spec: estimated 50% faster design-to-build in an internal pilot.** Designers build production-shaped prototypes that engineers and agents can build from directly.
- **AI-run experiments: idea to first build down to 3 days from 30.** An AI orchestrator coordinates agents across building, testing, and analysis, and people make the critical calls.


## Rethink how your teams build products


We’re sharing what we’ve learned from redesigning our own PDLC, so you can do the same.
